description: McCormick is a global leader in flavor, manufacturing, marketing and distributing herbs, spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavorful products to the entire food and beverage industry, including retailers, food manufacturers and foodservice businesses, and it is also a partner in a number of joint ventures involved in the manufacture and sale of flavorful products, the most significant of which is McCormick de Mexico, with its major sales, distribution and production facilities located in North America, Europe and China and additional facilities based in Australia, Central America, Thailand and South Africa. On January 2, 2026 it completed the purchase of an additional 25 percent ownership interest in McCormick de Mexico for a purchase price of $750 million, which increased its ownership to a 75 percent controlling interest, and it believes the acquisition creates opportunities for further growth in the Mexican market and provides a strategic platform for further expansion in Latin America.
